summary_1line: The Pandavas meet sage Arshtishena on Gandhamadana, receive guidance to remain humble, and later Bhima ascends toward Kubera’s realm and battles Yakshas and Rakshasas.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the slopes of Gandhamadana, blossoming trees, waterfalls, and white four-tusked elephants surround a blue lake as celestial beings and birds fill the air.
Bhima, massive and lion-like, climbs a narrow mountain path with bow, sword, and mace, striding toward the glittering golden city of Kubera.
Yakshas and Rakshasas rush through the air and over the ground with maces and spears as Bhima stands amid them, releasing arrows in all directions.
